job.label: Before ~600 BCE (disputed)
job.note: Britannica dates the prose frame before the 6th century BCE. Hayes says scholars disagree on Job's date. The Bible Dictionary gives no date.

job.label: ~600 - 300 BCE (disputed)
job.note: Britannica dates the poetry to the 6th-4th centuries BCE, with 28 and 32-37 probably later. Hayes says probably no earlier than the 6th century. Job 42:7-17 is prose frame.

psalms.label: ~1000 - 300 BCE
psalms.note: Britannica says the psalms span the early monarchy to post-exilic times. Hayes places the anthology in the 5th or 4th century, so the end moves to ~300.

proverbs.label: ~400 - 300 BCE
proverbs.note: Britannica dates chapters 1-9, the latest collection, to the 4th century BC. Hayes says the book reached final form in post-exilic times.

proverbs.label: After ~700 BCE (disputed)
proverbs.note: Britannica puts all collections after Solomon; the earliest (25-29) is about 700 BC. Hayes says much material is older. Tradition credits Solomon.

proverbs.label: ~715 - 686 BCE
proverbs.note: The heading credits Hezekiah's men; Britannica dates the collection about 700 BC. The Church reign table gives Hezekiah 715-686, as in the Isaiah labels.

proverbs.label: Date unknown
proverbs.note: The Bible Dictionary names Agur and Lemuel but gives no date. Britannica gives no separate date for these chapters.

ecclesiastes.label: ~400 - 200 BCE
ecclesiastes.note: Hayes suggests perhaps a 4th-century date. Britannica dates it about the second half of the 3rd century BCE. The range covers both views.

song-of-solomon.label: After ~500 BCE (final form)
song-of-solomon.note: Britannica dates the present form after the Exile (5th century onward); some poems may be older. Hayes calls the lyrics post-exilic. No source gives an end date.

jeremiah.label: ~627 - 609 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 1:2 dates the call to Josiah's 13th year (627/626 per Britannica). The Bible Dictionary assigns 1-6 to Josiah, who died in 609.

jeremiah.label: ~609 - 598 BCE
jeremiah.note: The Bible Dictionary assigns 7-20 to Jehoiakim's reign. The Church reign table gives Jehoiakim 609-598.

jeremiah.label: ~609 - 588 BCE
jeremiah.note: These chapters address kings from Shallum to Zedekiah. Jer 21:1 reflects the final siege (588); 24:1 follows Jeconiah's exile.

jeremiah.label: ~605 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 25:1 equates Jehoiakim's 4th year with Nebuchadnezzar's 1st. The Babylonian Chronicle puts his accession in 605.

jeremiah.label: ~609 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 26:1 dates the temple sermon to the beginning of Jehoiakim's reign, which began in 609.

jeremiah.label: ~597 - 593 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 27:3 and 28:1 point to Zedekiah's 4th year; 29:2 follows the 597 deportation. Zedekiah reigned 597-586.

jeremiah.label: ~597 - 587 BCE
jeremiah.note: The Bible Dictionary places 30-33 under Zedekiah. Jer 32:1 dates the field purchase to his 10th year, Nebuchadnezzar's 18th (588/587).

jeremiah.label: ~588 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 34:1 sets the oracle during the Babylonian siege, which 52:4 dates to Zedekiah's 9th year.

jeremiah.label: ~605 - 598 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 35 is set under Jehoiakim while Nebuchadnezzar's army was in the land. No opened source fixes the year more closely than 605-598.

jeremiah.label: ~605 - 604 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 36:1 and 36:9 name Jehoiakim's 4th and 5th years. These match 605/604 by the Babylonian Chronicle synchronism.

jeremiah.label: ~588 - 586 BCE
jeremiah.note: The siege runs from Zedekiah's 9th to 11th year (39:1-2). Livius dates the fall to 587 or 586; Church sources use 586.

jeremiah.label: ~586 - 567 BCE
jeremiah.note: These chapters follow the fall and the flight to Egypt. Jer 44:30 names Pharaoh Hophra (Apries), who reigned 589-567. No source supports 580.

jeremiah.label: ~605 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 45:1 dates Baruch's oracle to Jehoiakim's 4th year (605).

jeremiah.label: ~605 - 597 BCE
jeremiah.note: Only 46:2 (Carchemish, 605) and 49:34 (start of Zedekiah's reign, 597) carry dates. The other oracles are undated.

jeremiah.label: ~594 - 539 BCE
jeremiah.note: Jer 51:59 links the scroll to Zedekiah's 4th year. The Bible Dictionary says 50-51 are later in present form; Babylon fell about 539.

jeremiah.label: ~588 - 561 BCE
jeremiah.note: The chapter runs from the siege to Jehoiachin's release in Evil-merodach's first year. Nebuchadnezzar died in 562.

lamentations.label: ~586 - 539 BCE
lamentations.note: Britannica dates the poems to the exile after 586. The Bible Dictionary says some years after the fall. Hayes dates Cyrus's conquest about 539; no source supports 520.

ezekiel.label: ~593 BCE
ezekiel.note: Ezek 1:2 dates the call to the 5th year of Jehoiachin's exile. Hayes and Britannica give 593; the Bible Dictionary gives 592.

ezekiel.label: ~593 - 588 BCE
ezekiel.note: Britannica dates the judgment oracles from the call to the fall. Ezek 24:1 (9th year) matches the siege start in 588.

ezekiel.label: ~587 - 571 BCE
ezekiel.note: Britannica puts the foreign oracles about 586-585. Dated verses run from the 10th year (29:1) to the 27th year (29:17), about 571.

ezekiel.label: ~585 - 570 BCE
ezekiel.note: Ezek 33:21 reports the fall in the 12th year. Britannica and the Bible Dictionary place restoration oracles after that, with activity to about 570.

ezekiel.label: ~573 BCE
ezekiel.note: Ezek 40:1 dates the temple vision to the 25th year of exile, counted from the 597 deportation.

daniel.label: ~605 - 562 BCE (setting)
daniel.note: The stories are set under Nebuchadnezzar (605-562); Britannica notes no deportation in 605. Hayes dates chapters 1-6 perhaps to the late 3rd century; tradition says 6th century.

daniel.label: ~539 BCE (setting)
daniel.note: These stories are set at Babylon's fall (about 539). Hayes says Darius the Mede is unknown to history. The composition view follows chapters 1-4.

daniel.label: ~167 - 164 BCE (disputed)
daniel.note: Hayes and Britannica date the visions to Antiochus IV's persecution, 167-164 BCE. The traditional view dates them to Daniel in the 6th century, as their headings state.

hosea.label: ~750 - 722 BCE
hosea.note: Hayes places Hosea in the 740s-720s, before Israel fell in 722. Britannica and the Bible Dictionary start him late in Jeroboam II's reign.

joel.label: After ~516 BCE (disputed)
joel.note: Britannica places Joel in the Second Temple period (after 516). Hayes calls it probably the latest prophetic book. The Bible Dictionary allows a date before 850 BC.

amos.label: ~750 BCE
amos.note: Hayes dates Amos around 750 under Jeroboam II. Britannica and the Bible Dictionary name Jeroboam II and Uzziah. No opened source gives 760.

obadiah.label: After ~586 BCE (disputed)
obadiah.note: Britannica says many scholars date it after 586; others allow the 9th century. The Bible Dictionary prefers 586. No source supports an end date of 500.

jonah.label: ~500 - 300 BCE (written)
jonah.note: The story is set under Jeroboam II. Britannica dates the book to the 5th or 4th century; Hayes and the Bible Dictionary call it later than the prophet.

micah.label: ~740 - 700 BCE
micah.note: Hayes dates Micah 740-700. Britannica credits chapters 1-3 to him in the late 8th century.

micah.label: ~740 - 500 BCE (disputed)
micah.note: Britannica credits 6:1-7:7 to Micah but dates 4-5 and 7:8-20 generally centuries later. Some promises may come from Micah himself.

nahum.label: ~664 - 612 BCE
nahum.note: Nahum 3:8 recalls the fall of Thebes (Livius 664; Bible Dictionary about 660). Britannica and Hayes tie the book to Nineveh's fall in 612.

habakkuk.label: ~626 - 586 BCE
habakkuk.note: Britannica allows any time after 626, possibly before 612. Hayes dates it 600 to the destruction; the Bible Dictionary says about 600.

zephaniah.label: ~640 - 609 BCE
zephaniah.note: Zeph 1:1 names Josiah (640-609). Britannica dates the sayings about 640-630; Hayes puts some before the 622 reform.

haggai.label: ~520 BCE
haggai.note: Hag 1:1 names Darius's 2nd year. Hayes and the Bible Dictionary give 520; Britannica gives 521.

zechariah.label: ~520 - 518 BCE
zechariah.note: Dated headings run from Darius's 2nd to 4th year. The Bible Dictionary and Britannica give 520-518.

zechariah.label: ~500 - 200 BCE (disputed)
zechariah.note: Hayes dates 9-14 to the 5th century or later. Britannica dates 9-11 and 12-14 to the 4th and 3rd centuries. The Bible Dictionary treats them as Zechariah's.

malachi.label: ~516 - 430 BCE
malachi.note: Britannica dates it after the 516 temple and before about 450. The Bible Dictionary gives about 430. The range covers both.
